name: flowforge
description: FlowForge: a visual workflow automation tool inspired by n8n

scripts.dev: npm run build -w shared && concurrently -k -n shared,server,web -c magenta,cyan,green "npm run dev -w shared" "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.test: npm run build -w shared && npm run typecheck && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test:e2e: node scripts/build.mjs --if-stale && npm run test:e2e -w web
